remarks: Discover the perfect blend of charm and modern luxury in this stunning 4-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom home. Lovingly crafted and thoughtfully updated-reflected in the details of the home and surrounding landscape. Step inside to wide-board floors, beautiful windows allowing for sun-drenched living spaces and completely private views from almost every room. The heart of the home is the fully remodeled kitchen, with seamless flow for both casual meals and elegant entertaining with adjoining, Vaulted ceiling great room with reclaimed barn beams. Built-ins and abundant storage throughout the home ensure practicality for busy households. The main floor primary suite is a serene retreat, featuring a renovated en suite bath with heated floors, a soaking tub, and separate steam shower. Three additional over-sized bedrooms all feature natural light and large closets. Outdoor living is equally impressive with flexible entertaining spaces across multiple levels. Enjoy the stone patios and custom fire pit, recently redone for lasting beauty. A fenced garden bed at the rear of the lot and a greenhouse off the garage both invite creativity to bloom, while the barn (with electricity) presents an incredible opportunity -whether as an artist's studio, yoga space, home office; the options are endless. Perfectly situated 5 min from Wilton Town Center and local amenities, this home offers both privacy and convenience.
